audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer rated this HARD 8/10 with Ryze winning all seven chart rows, while the packet levelChart, the content win[] column and a 53.03% win rate over 2010 games all put Katarina on every row. The page contradicted itself on the headline verdict.
audit.why: Ryze's only answer to a Katarina all-in is Rune Prison, an 11s point-blank root at rank 1. Everything else in the kit is a dodgeable line (Overload, 1000 range) or a utility ult that deals no damage at all.
audit.corrected: EVEN at 5.5/10 with Katarina on every row, and both difficulty strings rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named no timing and breakdown.cooldowns carried no digit; content wants.you[1] gave Rune Prison as '~13s early'.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s — 11s at rank 1, not 13. Overload is a flat 5s and resets off his other casts; Spell Flux is 3.5s at rank 1; Realm Warp is 180s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into cooldowns, the spikes line and the wants entry.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated the two interactions that decide the lane: Rune Prison only ROOTS if the target already has Flux on them, and Realm Warp does no damage.
audit.why: Riot's W text: it damages and slows, and 'if the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted'. So the root that cancels Death Lotus requires a Spell Flux hit first — if you have no Flux debuff, his W is a slow and your channel survives it. Riot's R text is a portal with no damage component.
audit.corrected: Avoid standing in his E-marked minions before you commit, and treat his ult as a roam tool, not a fight button.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2].t reads 'All-in into spell-shield kits unbroken' — Ryze has no spell shield.
audit.why: Nothing in his kit carries the spellShield flag; his defensive layer is the W slow/root plus raw mana-scaling durability.
audit.corrected: Retitled around Flux, which is the real precondition to avoid.
